pattern: CL-02 unexpected invoice after a warranty repair; CF landlord asked for a charge-free service and no quote was approved
notes: Mutation of event 062 (originally Harbour confirming the repair was completed under warranty with no charge to the landlord). Same channel, sender and timestamp; Harbour now attach invoice HS-24117 for £168.00 inc VAT for the 22 May inspection and manufacturer liaison. The landlord asked for a charge-free warranty service (event 006); the job instruction (event 013) told Harbour to quote and wait for approval before chargeable work; no quote or approval for the inspection exists. History truncated after event 062. Visible events 014, 019, 020, 025, 028 and 029 (where shown) have the source's typo dates corrected so the only conflict is the one under test: the oven was fitted in March 2023 (source: 'March 2025', impossible in May 2024 and contradicting 'just out of its 12 month warranty'), and the inspection booked by phone at event 018 for 'the next day at 2:30 PM' is Wednesday 22 May 2024 (source: 'tomorrow, 21st June'; event 027 later records 22/05/2024). The date conflict itself is tested by the base cut 025-warranty-dates. Expected: record the completion, approve nothing, ask Harbour for the basis and put the invoice to the landlord; confirm the oven works with the tenant; escalating to accounts is acceptable if nothing is paid.
